findings.title: Per-value eligibility validation accepts contradictory projection-use flags
findings.requirement: Eligibility drift must fail closed before player values, team totals, roster values or ranks emit.
findings.root_cause: isPaidValueEligible validates only state, numeric_offensive_paid_value_available, and projection_policy; it does not validate the remaining safety-bearing exclusion, influence, zero-substitution, and fabricated-coverage fields.

reproduction.surface: real Chromium paid analysis with intercepted deterministic league data
reproduction.expected: No numeric paid player value, rank, roster value, or team total is emitted.
reproduction.actual: #playerValues .lv-value resolved to 1 numeric element instead of 0; the valuation remained eligible for downstream paid surfaces.

findings.title: Analysis-wide eligibility drift still emits eligible status and numeric zero team totals
findings.requirement: PAID_VALUE_ELIGIBLE may be emitted only with CONTEXT_ONLY_NOT_IN_VALUATION, and drift must fail closed before team totals emit without zero substitution.
findings.root_cause: The pipeline has no single validated analysis-wide eligibility gate. It renders valuation/team surfaces before separately copying an unvalidated top-level eligibility object and unconditional paid-eligible status into the page.

top_level_drift.expected: No PAID_VALUE_ELIGIBLE state or numeric paid output.
top_level_drift.actual: The page emitted data-state=PAID_VALUE_ELIGIBLE beside data-projection-policy=DRIFTED_UNSAFE_POLICY and displayed paid-value-eligible text.

value_level_policy_drift.expected: The paid team surface is withheld as unavailable.
value_level_policy_drift.actual: Player and roster values were suppressed, but 4 numeric team metric elements were emitted as empty-set zeros and the page still declared paid value eligible.
